kp1:1.1: NAMO TASSA BHAGAVATO ARAHATO SAMMĀSAMBUDDHASSA. Khuddaka-Pāṭha. I.
kp1:2.1: Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
kp1:3.1: Dutiyam pi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dutiyam pi dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dutiyam pi saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
kp1:4.1: Tatiyam pi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi tatiyam pi dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi tatiyam pi saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
